description: Real public datasets for comparing rsearch with vsearch. Fetch with rscompare fetch; see docs/datasets.md. Command lines are vsearch's, without the program name; {dir} is the dataset's directory (relative names resolve there), outputs are moved by rscompare.

datasets.title: The gut microbiome can transmit environmental responses to the next generation [16s-amplicon]
datasets.citation: Zare A, Johansson AM, Karlsson E, Delhomme N, Stenberg P (2018) The gut microbiome participates in transgenerational inheritance of low-temperature responses in Drosophila melanogaster. FEBS Lett 592:4078-4086. PMID 30372516.
datasets.licence: INSDC/GEO public data: no restrictions on use or redistribution (NCBI and ENA data-use policies); cite the paper and accessions.
datasets.environment: Drosophila melanogaster food and faeces (bacteria); includes a no-template control (NTC, SRR6782235)
datasets.target: 16S rRNA V3-V4 (341F CCTACGGGNGGCWGCAG / 805R GACTACHVGGGTATCTAATCC), primers not removed
datasets.label_format: @SRR6782207.1 1/1 and @SRR6782207.1 1/2: the run accession is the sample name otutab reads from the label (letters, digits and _ before the first other character)
datasets.notes: About a third of the reads of the small samples are all N (failed clusters): realistic input for the filters.

runs.sample_title: NTC

vsearch: --fastq_filter all_R1.fastq --reverse all_R2.fastq --fastq_stripleft 17 --fastq_truncqual 10 --fastq_minlen 150 --fastqout f_R1.fq --fastqout_rev f_R2.fq --fastqout_discarded d_R1.fq --fastqout_discarded_rev d_R2.fq

datasets.title: Testing the limits of 454 pyrotag sequencing: reproducibility, quantitative assessment and comparison to T-RFLP fingerprinting of aquifer microbes
datasets.citation: Pilloni G, Granitsiotis MS, Engel M, Lueders T (2012) PLoS One 7:e40467. PMID 22808168.
datasets.licence: INSDC/GEO public data: no restrictions on use or redistribution (NCBI and ENA data-use policies); cite the paper and accessions.
datasets.environment: Tar-oil contaminated aquifer sediment (Duesseldorf), biological and technical replicates, some spiked with Aliivibrio fischeri DNA
datasets.target: 16S rRNA V1-V3 region, read from the reverse primer 519r (reads are reverse-complemented amplicons)
datasets.notes: The SFF originals of these runs are in the SRA but only through cloud data delivery (s3://sra-pub-src-*, not anonymous); see ena-454-sff-mouse for SFF.

datasets.title: Gastrointestinal microbiota of wild and inbred house mouse
datasets.citation: ENA study PRJEB6634 (ERP006183), Department of Zoology (University of Kiel); no publication is linked in ENA.
datasets.licence: INSDC public data: no restrictions on use or redistribution (ENA data-use policy); cite the accessions.
datasets.quality_encoding: SFF (binary flowgrams and Phred scores); ENA FASTQ Phred+33 (Q0-Q40)
datasets.label_format: SFF read names (e.g. G99W42T01BNAO8); ENA FASTQ @ERR550421.1 ...
datasets.notes: GEO-linked 454 runs (GSE35631) keep their SFF only in the SRA cloud bucket, which needs authenticated delivery; these ENA-submitted SFF files are anonymous HTTPS. The SFF files are not subsampled by --max-reads.

datasets.citation: SRA study SRP353264 (BioProject PRJNA793712), Chinese Academy of Sciences; no publication is linked in the SRA.
datasets.licence: INSDC public data: no restrictions on use or redistribution (NCBI and ENA data-use policies); cite the accessions.
datasets.target: Fungal ITS1 (ITS1F CTTGGTCATTTAGAGGAAGTAA / ITS2 GCTGCGTTCTTCATCGATGC), primers not removed, 5-nt pad before the forward primer

datasets.title: Diversity, Ecology and Biogeochemistry of cyst-forming acantharia (Radiolaria) in the oceans
datasets.citation: Decelle J, Martin P, Paborstava K, Pond DW, Tarling G, Mahe F, de Vargas C, Lampitt R, Not F (2013) PLoS One 8:e53598. PMID 23326463.
datasets.licence: INSDC public data: no restrictions on use or redistribution (ENA data-use policy); cite the paper and accessions.
datasets.environment: Marine plankton (Tara Oceans), size fractions 0.8-5 and 0.8-3 um, surface and mesopelagic
datasets.quality_encoding: Phred+64 (Illumina 1.5+, Q4-Q40) in the submitted files; Phred+33 in ENA FASTQ
datasets.label_format: @BISMUTH_0000:8:1:17130:1918#TTAGGC/1, with the label repeated on the + line
datasets.notes: ENA converts its own FASTQ to Phred+33; the submitted files (vol1/run/...) keep Phred+64. ERR205066 comes in both, so conv --ascii 64 can be checked against ENA's conversion (labels differ).
